name: Beast of the Land
printing: First printing, September 2024, alternate-cover hardcover ISBN 978-0-7869-6982-1.
appearanceEvidence: The ranger chooses an animal suited to this form. It bears visible primal markings. The portrait shows a wolf.
errataEvidence: The official Player’s Handbook errata lists no change to this feature, spell or stat block.
ruleComparison: The registry’s numerical inputs and strike match. Command, restoration, Primal Bond and subclass advancement procedures are supplied as source prose.
mechanicsNotes: The extra 1d6 applies regardless of size. The Large-or-smaller limit applies only to Prone.

name: Beast of the Sea
printing: First printing, September 2024, alternate-cover hardcover ISBN 978-0-7869-6982-1.
appearanceEvidence: The ranger chooses an animal suited to this form. It bears visible primal markings. The portrait shows a crocodile.

ruleComparison: The read-only registry’s strike lists Piercing only and omits the escape DC. The ability array and scaling inputs match this first printing.
mechanicsNotes: The print gives Bludgeoning or Piercing and an escape DC equal to the ranger’s spell save DC. The Grappled condition is applied on the hit.

name: Bestial Spirit
printing: First printing, September 2024, alternate-cover hardcover ISBN 978-0-7869-6982-1.
appearanceEvidence: The caster chooses a native animal for the selected environment. The portrait shows a wolf as one Land example.
errataEvidence: The official Player’s Handbook errata lists no change to this feature, spell or stat block.
ruleComparison: AC, HP and Rend scale by slot level as printed. The calculator rounds down for Multiattack. The registry carries a Dexterity-derived initiative value. In play the spell uses the caster’s initiative count and its own turn immediately after the caster.
mechanicsNotes: The spell gives the spirit the caster’s initiative count and a turn immediately after the caster.
